_help: Settings read by the hook scripts in this folder. Edit per project. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_check_command: Run by verify_on_stop.py when Claude tries to finish with uncommitted changes. Empty string = disabled. Examples: 'uv run pytest -q', 'npm test', 'dotnet test', 'ruff check . && pytest -q'
_format_commands: Run after every edit, by file extension. {file} is replaced with the edited path. Skipped silently if the tool is not installed.
_lint_commands: Run after every edit. If the linter fails, its output is sent back to Claude so it fixes the problem right away.
_protected_paths: Glob patterns (relative to the project root) Claude may not edit. Secrets, lockfiles and .git are always protected.
